title: Notifications List API Contract
description: Draft USF-native interface contract for GET /v1/notifications. It promotes the implemented local route metadata into canonical interface-contract coverage while preserving OpenAPI as a lower-authority projection.
aiGuidance: Treat this interface contract as the route authority. Do not infer semantic authority from OpenAPI, route metadata, examples, generated reports, or handler structure.
purpose: Represent notifications.list as a governed GET API route contract for notification-service.
boundary: Local dev/test inbound HTTP boundary GET /v1/notifications; implementation path apps/api/src/server.ts; route classification tenant-scoped.

requestContract.description: Request semantics for notifications.list bind method, path, operation id, request schema, auth scheme, tenant scope, and required action before implementation handling. Request schema: TenantContextQuery.

responseContract.description: Response semantics for notifications.list expose 200 NotificationsListResponse, 400 ApiErrorResponse, 403 ApiErrorResponse; error responses use ApiErrorResponse. Audit, PDP, idempotency, rate-limit, correlation, field exposure, observability, gateway, and proof boundaries remain explicit contract terms.

security: Auth scheme dev-header-keycloak-bearer-future; tenant scope tenant-header-query; PDP policy notification capability calls PDP; audit policy notification list is PDP gated; idempotency policy not-required; pagination policy cursor; rate-limit policy local-dev-test quotas represented; live enforcement deferred; field exposure policy minimum necessary fields; sensitive internals redacted; observability policy tenant-safe request_count error_count validation_failure_count auth_denial_count; gateway policy local-dev-test-only gateway-edge-waf-tls-production-posture-deferred; error schema ApiErrorResponse; proof status is bounded local-dev-test evidence with no public API or live-provider claim.
